description: Whether the subscriber is enabled for IMS Centralized Services, which affects how the serving node handles SRVCC and CS fallback. Values are FALSE (0) and TRUE (1).

name: IMS-Voice-Over-PS-Sessions-Supported
description: Whether IMS voice over PS is supported in the tracking or routing area the UE used most recently. Values are NOT_SUPPORTED (0) and SUPPORTED (1); used for T-ADS.

name: Homogeneous-Support-of-IMS-Voice-Over-PS-Sessions
description: Whether IMS voice over PS is supported uniformly in every TA or RA of the serving node for this subscriber, including roaming agreements. Values are NOT_SUPPORTED (0) and SUPPORTED (1); absence means non-uniform or unknown.

name: Last-UE-Activity-Time
description: The time the serving node last had radio contact with the UE, reported for T-ADS.

name: EPS-User-State
description: The UE's state as known to the MME, the SGSN, or both, returned when the HSS asks for user state.

name: EPS-Location-Information
description: The UE's location as known to the MME, the SGSN, or both, returned when the HSS asks for location information.

name: MME-User-State
description: The UE's state as seen by the MME, wrapping a User-State value.

name: SGSN-User-State
description: The UE's state as seen by the SGSN, wrapping a User-State value.

name: User-State
description: The UE's EPS mobility and connection state. Values include DETACHED (0), ATTACHED_NOT_REACHABLE_FOR_PAGING (1), ATTACHED_REACHABLE_FOR_PAGING (2), CONNECTED_NOT_REACHABLE_FOR_PAGING (3), and CONNECTED_REACHABLE_FOR_PAGING (4).

name: AN-Trusted
description: The decision of the home network on whether a non-3GPP access network is handled as trusted. Values are TRUSTED (0) and UNTRUSTED (1). It is passed to the PCRF on Gx and to the AF on Rx.

name: Origination-Time-Stamp
description: The UTC time, in milliseconds since 1 January 1900, at which the entity that started a request sent it. It is copied from GTPv2, and on Gx the PCEF passes it so the PCRF can resolve colliding session requests.

name: Maximum-Wait-Time
description: How many milliseconds after the origination time stamp the originator waits for a response. A receiver can use it to drop requests that would arrive too late.

name: Emergency-Services
description: A bit mask for emergency handling. Bit 0, Emergency-Indication, marks a request to set up a PDN connection for emergency services.

name: MME-Location-Information
description: Location data from the MME: the E-UTRAN cell and tracking area, optional geographical or geodetic position, location age and whether it is current, CSG information, and the eNodeB ID.

name: SGSN-Location-Information
description: Location data from the SGSN: cell global identity, location, routing, or service area, optional geographical or geodetic position, location age and whether it is current, and CSG information.

name: E-UTRAN-Cell-Global-Identity
description: The E-UTRAN Cell Global Identifier (ECGI) of the cell where the UE is registered, coded as in MAP.

name: Tracking-Area-Identity
description: The Tracking Area Identity (TAI) where the UE is located, coded as in MAP.

name: Cell-Global-Identity
description: The GERAN/UTRAN Cell Global Identification of the UE's current cell, coded as in MAP.

name: Routing-Area-Identity
description: The Routing Area Identity (RAI) where the UE is located, coded as in MAP.

name: Location-Area-Identity
description: The Location Area Identification (LAI) where the UE is located, coded as in MAP.

name: Service-Area-Identity
description: The UTRAN Service Area Identifier (SAI) where the UE is located, coded as in MAP.

name: Geographical-Information
description: The UE's estimated geographical position in the octet format defined by MAP.

name: Geodetic-Information
description: The geodetic position of the user as reported by the MME or SGSN in its location information. The octet layout follows the MAP definition in TS 29.002.

name: Current-Location-Retrieved
description: Marks that the reported location is fresh rather than cached. Its only value, ACTIVE-LOCATION-RETRIEVAL (0), means the serving node paged an idle UE or queried the eNodeB of a connected UE to get the location.

name: Age-Of-Location-Information
description: How many minutes have passed since the network last had contact with the UE, so the receiver can judge how stale the reported location is.

name: Active-APN
description: Describes an APN that a serving node set up dynamically for the UE (for example a PDN-GW chosen at connection time). The HSS stores it so it can be given back to the node if that state is lost after a restart.

name: SIPTO-Permission
description: Per-APN subscription flag saying whether traffic for that APN may use SIPTO above RAN (selected IP traffic offload). Values are SIPTO_above_RAN_ALLOWED (0) and SIPTO_above_RAN_NOTALLOWED (1).

name: Error-Diagnostic
description: Extra detail returned with an Update Location error. With an unknown EPS subscription it tells whether GPRS data exists (GPRS_DATA_SUBSCRIBED (0), NO_GPRS_DATA_SUBSCRIBED (1)); with roaming not allowed it names the barring cause, such as ODB_ALL_APN (2), ODB_HPLMN_APN (3), or ODB_VPLMN_APN (4).

name: UE-SRVCC-Capability
description: Sent by the serving node to tell the HSS whether the UE can do SRVCC (voice handover from IMS to the circuit-switched domain). Values are UE-SRVCC-NOT-SUPPORTED (0) and UE-SRVCC-SUPPORTED (1).

name: MPS-Priority
description: Bit mask of the user's Multimedia Priority Service subscriptions. Bit 0 MPS-CS-Priority covers CS-domain priority (eMLPP or 1x RTT), and bit 1 MPS-EPS-Priority covers MPS in the EPS domain.

name: VPLMN-LIPA-Allowed
description: Tells a visited MME or SGSN whether the roaming user may use Local IP Access (LIPA) in that network. Values are LIPA_NOTALLOWED (0) and LIPA_ALLOWED (1).

name: LIPA-Permission
description: Per-APN setting for Local IP Access. LIPA_PROHIBITED (0) forbids LIPA for the APN, LIPA_ONLY (1) allows the APN only through LIPA, and LIPA_CONDITIONAL (2) allows both LIPA and normal access.

name: Subscribed-Periodic-RAU-TAU-Timer
description: The periodic routing area or tracking area update timer from the user's subscription, in seconds, which the serving node can apply to the UE.

name: Ext-PDP-Type
description: Extended PDP type carried in a GPRS PDP context to signal dual-stack IPv4v6 support. When it is present the SGSN uses it in place of the PDP-Type value. Defined in clause 7.3.75A.

name: Ext-PDP-Address
description: A second PDP address for a GPRS PDP context. It holds the other address family when the context is dual-stack IPv4v6.

name: MDT-Configuration
description: Minimization of Drive Tests (MDT) job settings for LTE, UMTS, and MBSFN, as defined in TS 32.422. It groups the job type, the area scope, the measurements to collect, the reporting and logging parameters, and the PLMNs where collection is allowed.

name: Job-Type
description: The kind of trace or MDT job to run, such as immediate MDT, logged MDT, or a combination with trace. The value set comes from TS 32.422.

name: Area-Scope
description: Limits an MDT job to a geographic area. The area is given as a list of cells, routing areas, location areas, or tracking areas, for LTE, UMTS, GSM, or NR.

name: List-Of-Measurements
description: Bit mask that selects which radio measurements an MDT job collects. The bit meanings are defined in TS 32.422.

name: Reporting-Trigger
description: Bit mask that selects what triggers MDT measurement reports, for example periodic reporting or specific radio events. The bit meanings are defined in TS 32.422.

name: Report-Interval
description: The period between reports for periodic immediate MDT. The enumerated values are those defined in TS 32.422.

name: Report-Amount
description: How many periodic reports an immediate MDT job sends, which can be a fixed count or unlimited. The enumerated values are those defined in TS 32.422.

name: Event-ThresholdRSRP
description: The RSRP threshold that triggers event-based MDT reporting in LTE or NR. The allowed range is defined in TS 32.422.

name: Event-ThresholdRSRQ
description: The RSRQ threshold that triggers event-based MDT reporting in LTE or NR. The allowed range is defined in TS 32.422.

name: Logging-Interval
description: For logged MDT, how often the UE records measurements while it is idle. The enumerated values are those defined in TS 32.422.

name: Logging-Duration
description: For logged MDT, how long the UE keeps logging after the job is configured. The enumerated values are those defined in TS 32.422.

name: Relay-Node-Indicator
description: Tells the MME whether the subscription is for an LTE Relay Node rather than an ordinary UE. Values are NOT_RELAY_NODE (0), the default when absent, and RELAY_NODE (1).

name: MDT-User-Consent
description: Whether the user has agreed to MDT data collection. Values are CONSENT_NOT_GIVEN (0), assumed when it is missing from ULA, and CONSENT_GIVEN (1). If it is missing from IDR, the stored consent is unchanged.

name: PUR-Flags
description: Bit mask in a Purge UE request from a combined MME/SGSN. It says which part of the node purged the UE: bit 0 is UE Purged in MME and bit 1 is UE Purged in SGSN.

name: Subscribed-VSRVCC
description: Shows that the user subscribes to vSRVCC (video call handover to the CS domain). Its only value is VSRVCC_SUBSCRIBED (0). If it is missing from ULA, the user has no vSRVCC; if it is missing from IDR, nothing changes.

name: Equivalent-PLMN-List
description: The list of PLMN IDs that the serving MME or SGSN treats as equivalent to the visited PLMN. The HSS can use it, for example, to return CSG data for those PLMNs.

name: CLR-Flags
description: Bit mask in a Cancel Location request. Bit 0 S6a/S6d-Indicator says whether the target is the MME part (set) or the SGSN part (clear). Bit 1 Reattach-Required asks the serving node to make the UE re-attach immediately.

name: Time-Zone
description: The UTC offset of the UE's location in the visited network, as a text string in 15-minute units with a sign, for example "+8" for two hours ahead. The value includes any daylight saving shift.

name: A-MSISDN
description: An Additional MSISDN for the user. It is an E.164 number encoded as TBCD digits only, with no nature-of-address or numbering plan prefix. It is sent in subscription data in ULA, or in IDR when the value changes.

name: MME-Number-for-MT-SMS
description: The ISDN number of the MME used for mobile-terminated SMS when the MME handles SMS itself. It is an E.164 number encoded as TBCD digits only.

name: SMS-Register-Request
description: Sent by the MME or SGSN to state its wish to be registered for SMS. Values are SMS_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED (0), SMS_REGISTRATION_NOT_PREFERRED (1), and NO_PREFERENCE (2).

name: Local-Time-Zone
description: The local time information for the UE's location in the visited network. It pairs the UTC offset (Time-Zone) with the daylight saving adjustment (Daylight-Saving-Time).

name: Daylight-Saving-Time
description: The daylight saving adjustment, in whole hours, that applies at the UE's location in the visited network. Values are NO_ADJUSTMENT (0), PLUS_ONE_HOUR_ADJUSTMENT (1), and PLUS_TWO_HOURS_ADJUSTMENT (2).

name: Subscription-Data-Flags
description: Bit mask of subscription attributes for the serving node. Bits include PS-And-SMS-Only-Service-Provision-Indication (0), SMS-In-SGSN-Allowed-Indication (1), User Plane Integrity Protection (2), PDN-Connection-Restricted (3), and a bit (4) that turns off acknowledgement of downlink NAS data PDUs.

name: Measurement-Period-LTE
description: The measurement period for LTE MDT measurements, such as data volume or throughput. The enumerated values are those defined in TS 32.422.

name: Measurement-Period-UMTS
description: The measurement period for UMTS MDT measurements. The enumerated values are those defined in TS 32.422.

name: Collection-Period-RRM-LTE
description: The collection period for LTE radio resource management measurements in an MDT job. The enumerated values are those defined in TS 32.422.

name: Collection-Period-RRM-UMTS
description: The collection period for UMTS radio resource management measurements in an MDT job. The enumerated values are those defined in TS 32.422.

name: Positioning-Method
description: A one-octet bit map that selects the positioning methods an MDT job uses to locate the UE. The bit values are defined in TS 32.422.

name: Measurement-Quantity
description: A one-octet bit map that selects the measurement quantity, such as CPICH Ec/No or RSCP, for UMTS MDT event reporting. The bit values are defined in TS 32.422.

name: Event-Threshold-Event-1F
description: The threshold for UMTS radio event 1F, which triggers an MDT report. The allowed values are defined in TS 32.422.

name: Event-Threshold-Event-1I
description: The threshold for UMTS radio event 1I, which triggers an MDT report. The allowed values are defined in TS 32.422.

name: Restoration-Priority
description: The priority of a user's PDN connection, compared with other connections to the same APN, when the network restores connections after an SGW or PGW failure. Values run from 1 to 16, and 1 is the highest priority.

name: SGs-MME-Identity
description: The identity of the MME on the SGs interface toward the MSC/VLR, in the format given in TS 23.003. The HSS uses it for SMS and CS interworking.

name: SIPTO-Local-Network-Permission
description: Per-APN flag saying whether traffic for that APN may use SIPTO at the local network. Value 0 means allowed and value 1 means not allowed.

name: Coupled-Node-Diameter-ID
description: The S6a or S6d Diameter identity of the coupled node. For a combined MME/SGSN, this is the other part of the node, so the HSS can link the two registrations.

name: WLAN-offloadability
description: Per-APN settings for offloading traffic to WLAN through WLAN/3GPP radio interworking. It holds separate bit masks for offload from E-UTRAN and offload from UTRAN.

name: Reset-ID
description: Identifies a resource in the HSS, unique within the HSS realm, that can fail or restart. In a Reset procedure it selects the affected subscribers, for example when shared subscription data is added, changed, or removed for many users.

name: MDT-Allowed-PLMN-Id
description: A PLMN (MCC and MNC, encoded as in the 24.008 PLMN list) where MDT data collection is allowed. A job can list several.

name: Adjacent-PLMNs
description: Sent by the MME or SGSN to list the PLMNs next to its own PLMN that a UE is likely to be handed over to. The HSS can return access restriction data for each one.

name: Adjacent-Access-Restriction-Data
description: Gives the access restriction data that applies to one adjacent PLMN. It pairs a PLMN ID with the RAT restriction bits for that PLMN.

name: DL-Buffering-Suggested-Packet-Count
description: Says whether the SGW buffers downlink data for longer for a high-latency (for example power-saving) UE. Value 0 means no extended buffering, -1 means buffering with no suggested size, and a positive value suggests how many packets to buffer.

name: IMSI-Group-Id
description: One IMSI group that the subscriber belongs to, used for group-based features. It holds the service the group applies to, the PLMN that defines the group, and the operator-chosen local group value.

name: Group-Service-Id
description: The service an IMSI group applies to. Value 1 is group-specific NAS level congestion control and value 2 is group-specific monitoring of the number of UEs in an area. Values above 1000 are for home-network specific use.

name: Group-PLMN-Id
description: The PLMN (MCC and MNC, encoded as in the 24.008 PLMN list) that defines an IMSI group.

name: Local-Group-Id
description: An operator-defined value that identifies a group within its IMSI group definition.

name: AIR-Flags
description: Bit mask in an Authentication Information request. Bit 0, Send UE Usage Type, asks the HSS to return the UE-Usage-Type with the authentication vectors so that a dedicated core network can be chosen early.

name: UE-Usage-Type
description: The usage class of the UE, used to pick a Dedicated Core Network. The range is 0 to 255: 0 to 127 are reserved for standards use and 128 to 255 are operator-specific.

name: Non-IP-PDN-Type-Indicator
description: Per-APN flag showing whether the APN uses the Non-IP PDN type. TRUE (1) means it does, and the receiver then ignores PDN-Type. FALSE (0) is the default.

name: Non-IP-Data-Delivery-Mechanism
description: For a Non-IP APN, how the data is delivered. SGi-BASED-DATA-DELIVERY (0), the default, uses a point-to-point tunnel over SGi; SCEF-BASED-DATA-DELIVERY (1) sends the data through the SCEF.

name: Additional-Context-Identifier
description: The context identifier of a second default APN. It is used when a subscription mixes PDN type categories (IP, Non-IP, Ethernet), so each category can have its own default APN. Defined in clause 7.3.206.

name: SCEF-Realm
description: The Diameter realm of the SCEF. In S6a monitoring event configuration, the HSS fills it from the realm of the SCEF that set up the event, so the MME can route reports to it.

name: Subscription-Data-Deletion
description: Used in a Reset (DSR) to name shared subscription data to remove from every affected subscriber. It can point at APN contexts, a trace reference, teleservice or supplementary service codes, or an SCEF's monitoring data.

name: Preferred-Data-Mode
description: Per-APN bit mask for the preferred CIoT data path on E-UTRAN. Bit 0 means data over the user plane is preferred and bit 1 means data over the control plane (NAS) is preferred. At least one bit is set, and both may be.

name: Emergency-Info
description: Holds the PDN-GW used for the UE's emergency PDN connections, so the HSS can store it and give it to a new serving node, for example after a move to non-3GPP access.

name: V2X-Subscription-Data
description: The user's V2X subscription data for network-scheduled LTE sidelink communication. It holds the V2X permission bits and the aggregate bitrate allowed on the LTE PC5 interface.

name: V2X-Permission
description: Bit mask of the V2X services the user may use over PC5 in the serving PLMN. Bit 0 allows communication as a vehicle UE and bit 1 allows communication as a pedestrian UE.

name: PDN-Connection-Continuity
description: Per-APN rule for what happens to a PDN connection when the UE moves between broadband and narrowband RATs. Values are MAINTAIN-PDN-CONNECTION (0), DISCONNECT-PDN-CONNECTION-WITH-REACTIVATION-REQUEST (1), and DISCONNECT-PDN-CONNECTION-WITHOUT-REACTIVATION-REQUEST (2).

name: eDRX-Cycle-Length
description: A subscribed extended DRX cycle length together with the RAT type it applies to, for example WB-E-UTRAN or NB-IoT. The subscription can include one per RAT.

name: eDRX-Cycle-Length-Value
description: The subscribed extended DRX cycle value for one RAT, in a single octet. The low four bits carry the "eDRX value" field from the 24.008 Extended DRX parameter IE, and the high four bits are zero.

name: UE-PC5-AMBR
description: The aggregate maximum bitrate, in bits per second, that the UE may send over the PC5 sidelink interface for V2X. It applies to LTE or NR PC5, depending on the parent AVP.

name: MBSFN-Area
description: Limits MDT collection to MBSFN areas. With both an area ID and a carrier frequency it names one area. With only a frequency it covers every area on that carrier, and with neither it covers any area.

name: MBSFN-Area-ID
description: The identifier of an MBSFN area, from 0 to 255, as defined in the LTE RRC specification.

name: Carrier-Frequency
description: The carrier frequency (EARFCN, from 0 to 262143) of an MBSFN area used in MDT scoping.

name: RDS-Indicator
description: Per-APN flag for the Reliable Data Service used with Non-IP data delivery. Values are DISABLED (0), the default, and ENABLED (1).

name: Service-Gap-Time
description: The Service Gap Control time in seconds. After leaving ECM-CONNECTED, the UE must stay idle for at least this long before it may request a new connection.

name: Aerial-UE-Subscription-Information
description: Whether the user is subscribed to the Aerial UE (for example drone) function. Values are AERIAL_UE_ALLOWED (0) and AERIAL_UE_NOT_ALLOWED (1). The value is passed on to the eNodeB.

name: Broadcast-Location-Assistance-Data-Types
description: A 64-bit mask of the positioning SIB types for which the UE subscribes to receive ciphering keys, so it can decrypt broadcast location assistance data. Each bit maps to one SIB type, such as Positioning SIB Type 1-1 (bit 0) or Type 2-1 (bit 7).

name: Paging-Time-Window
description: A subscribed eDRX Paging Time Window length together with the operation mode (Iu, WB-S1, or NB-S1) it applies to.

name: Operation-Mode
description: The radio operation mode a Paging Time Window length applies to. Defined values are 1 (Iu mode), 2 (WB-S1 mode), and 3 (NB-S1 mode); the rest of the 0 to 255 range is spare.

name: Paging-Time-Window-Length
description: The subscribed Paging Time Window length for one operation mode, in a single octet. The high four bits carry the PTW field from the 24.008 Extended DRX parameter IE, and the low four bits are zero.

name: Core-Network-Restrictions
description: Bit mask of core network types the user is not allowed to use. Bit 1, 5GC not allowed, bars access to the 5G core. Bit 0 is reserved and deprecated.

name: eDRX-Related-RAT
description: The RAT types to which an eDRX cycle length relates, given as one or more RAT-Type values.

name: Interworking-5GS-Indicator
description: Per-APN flag saying whether interworking between EPS and 5GS is subscribed for that APN. Values are NOT-SUBSCRIBED (0), the default, and SUBSCRIBED (1).

name: Ethernet-PDN-Type-Indicator
description: Per-APN flag showing whether the APN uses the Ethernet PDN type. TRUE (1) means it does, and the receiver then ignores PDN-Type. FALSE (0) is the default.

name: Subscribed-ARPI
description: The subscribed Additional RRM Policy Index for the user. The MME passes it to the RAN so it can apply operator-specific radio resource policies.

name: IAB-Operation-Permission
description: Tells the MME or SGSN whether the UE may act as an Integrated Access and Backhaul (IAB) node. Values are IAB_OPERATION_ALLOWED (0) and IAB_OPERATION_NOTALLOWED (1).

name: V2X-Subscription-Data-Nr
description: The user's V2X subscription data for network-scheduled NR sidelink communication. It holds the V2X permissions, the NR PC5 aggregate bitrate, and the PC5 QoS parameters.

name: UE-PC5-QoS
description: The PC5 QoS parameters for V2X over the NR PC5 reference point. It holds one or more per-flow QoS entries and an optional link aggregate bitrate for non-GBR flows.

name: PC5-QoS-Flow
description: The QoS settings for one PC5 flow: its PQI (a 5QI value), optional GBR bitrates, and an optional communication range.

name: 5QI
description: A 5G QoS Identifier from TS 23.501. When used for PC5 QoS it carries a PQI, the PC5-specific 5QI defined in TS 23.287.

name: PC5-Flow-Bitrates
description: The guaranteed and maximum bitrates for a PC5 QoS flow. It applies only to GBR flows.

name: Guaranteed-Flow-Bitrates
description: The guaranteed bitrate, in bits per second, for a GBR PC5 QoS flow sent by the UE over the PC5 interface.

name: Maximum-Flow-Bitrates
description: The maximum bitrate, in bits per second, for a PC5 QoS flow sent by the UE over the PC5 interface.

name: PC5-Range
description: The communication range, in meters, that applies to a PC5 QoS flow for NR V2X.

name: PC5-Link-AMBR
description: The aggregate bitrate limit, in bits per second, shared by all non-GBR QoS flows on a PC5 link.

name: MDT-Configuration-NR
description: MDT job settings for NR, as defined in TS 32.422. This release covers only immediate MDT. It groups the job type, area scope, measurements, reporting triggers and thresholds (including SINR), NR collection periods, positioning, sensor measurements, and allowed PLMNs.

name: Event-Threshold-SINR
description: The SINR threshold that triggers event-based MDT reporting in NR. The allowed values are defined in TS 32.422.

name: Collection-Period-RRM-NR
description: The collection period for NR radio resource management measurements in an MDT job. The enumerated values are those defined in TS 32.422.

name: Collection-Period-M6-NR
description: The collection period for the NR M6 (packet delay) MDT measurement. The enumerated values are those defined in TS 32.422.

name: Collection-Period-M7-NR
description: The collection period, in minutes, for the NR M7 (packet loss) MDT measurement. The allowed values are defined in TS 32.422.

name: Sensor-Measurement
description: A sensor reading an NR MDT job asks the UE to report. Values are BAROMETRIC_PRESSURE (0), UE_SPEED (1), and UE_ORIENTATION (2).

name: Trace-Reporting-Consumer-Uri
description: The URI of the consumer that receives trace data in streaming-based trace reporting. If a Trace-Collection-Entity is also present, this URI takes precedence.

name: PDN-Connection-Charging-ID
description: A charging ID that groups the charging records of one PDN connection, usually the charging ID of its first bearer. With the PGW address it identifies the connection. The PCEF can send it to the PCRF on Gx.

name: Dynamic-Address-Flag
description: Says whether the UE address for the PDP context or PDN connection was assigned dynamically. Values are Static (0) and Dynamic (1); absence means static.

name: Dynamic-Address-Flag-Extension
description: For an IPv4v6 PDN connection, says whether the IPv4 address was assigned dynamically, while Dynamic-Address-Flag covers the IPv6 part. Values are Static (0) and Dynamic (1).

name: User-CSG-Information
description: Closed Subscriber Group information for the cell the UE uses: the CSG ID, the cell access mode, and whether the user is a member when the cell is hybrid. It is reported over Gx and in S6a location information.

name: LMSI
description: The Local Mobile Station Identity that a VLR assigned to the subscriber (TS 23.003), returned by the HSS so the GMLC can address the MSC.

name: Serving-Node
description: Describes the node currently serving the target user, such as an SGSN, MME, MSC, or 3GPP AAA server, with its names, realms, numbers, LCS capability sets, and the GMLC tied to it.

name: MME-Name
description: Diameter identity (host name) of the MME serving the target user.

name: MSC-Number
description: E.164 number of the MSC or MSC server serving the user, in international format and encoded as a TBCD string.

name: LCS-Capabilities-Sets
description: Bit mask showing which LCS capability sets the serving node supports, with bit meanings taken from TS 29.002.

name: GMLC-Address
description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of the home or visited GMLC associated with the serving node, used so that location messages reach the right GMLC.

name: Additional-Serving-Node
description: Details of a further node that also serves the target user, alongside the main Serving-Node, with the same kinds of names, realms, numbers, capabilities, and GMLC address.

name: PPR-Address
description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of the Privacy Profile Register that holds the target user's location privacy settings.

name: MME-Realm
description: Diameter realm of the MME serving the target user.

name: SGSN-Name
description: Diameter identity (host name) of the SGSN serving the target user.

name: SGSN-Realm
description: Diameter realm of the SGSN serving the target user.

name: RIA-Flags
description: Bit mask sent by the HSS in an LCS-Routing-Info-Answer. Bit 0 Combined-MME/SGSN-Supporting-Optimized-LCS-Proc shows that one combined MME/SGSN serves the UE and supports the optimized LCS procedure.

name: SLg-Location-Type
description: Tells the MME or SGSN what kind of location the GMLC wants in a Provide-Location-Request. Values include CURRENT_LOCATION (0), CURRENT_OR_LAST_KNOWN_LOCATION (1), INITIAL_LOCATION (2), ACTIVATE_DEFERRED_LOCATION (3), CANCEL_DEFERRED_LOCATION (4), and NOTIFICATION_VERIFICATION_ONLY (5).

name: LCS-EPS-Client-Name
description: Names the external LCS client that asked for the location. The group holds the client's name string and an indicator of how that name is formatted (both defined in TS 32.299).

name: LCS-Requestor-Name
description: Identifies the party that originated the request at the LCS client side. The group holds a requestor identity string and a format indicator for it (both defined in TS 32.299).

name: LCS-Priority
description: Priority of the location request. Zero means highest priority and one means normal priority; the receiver treats any other number as normal priority.

name: LCS-QoS
description: Quality of service the LCS client wants for the location estimate. The group covers the QoS class, the wanted horizontal and vertical accuracy, whether a vertical coordinate is needed, and the acceptable response time.

name: Velocity-Requested
description: Says whether the GMLC also wants the UE's velocity along with its position. Values are VELOCITY_IS_NOT_REQUESTED (0), the default when absent, and VELOCITY_IS_REQUESTED (1).

name: LCS-Codeword
description: Codeword string that the network can include in the notification it sends to the target UE, letting the user recognize who is asking for the location.

name: LCS-Privacy-Check
description: Privacy action to apply toward the target user for a location request. Values include ALLOWED_WITHOUT_NOTIFICATION (0), the default, ALLOWED_WITH_NOTIFICATION (1), ALLOWED_IF_NO_RESPONSE (2), RESTRICTED_IF_NO_RESPONSE (3), and NOT_ALLOWED (4).

name: Accuracy-Fulfilment-Indicator
description: Reports whether the returned location estimate meets the accuracy the client asked for. Values are REQUESTED_ACCURACY_FULFILLED (0) and REQUESTED_ACCURACY_NOT_FULFILLED (1).

name: Age-Of-Location-Estimate
description: How old the returned location estimate is, counted in minutes since the position was obtained, following the TS 29.002 convention.

name: Velocity-Estimate
description: The UE's estimated velocity, encoded as an octet string of at least four octets using the velocity formats of TS 23.032.

name: EUTRAN-Positioning-Data
description: Positioning data for a UE on E-UTRAN, carrying the encoded Positioning-Data element from TS 29.171 that describes which positioning methods were used.

name: ECGI
description: The E-UTRAN Cell Global Identifier of the cell serving the target UE, encoded as in the GTPv2 ECGI field of TS 29.274.

name: Location-Event
description: The event that triggered a Location-Report-Request from the MME or SGSN. Values include EMERGENCY_CALL_ORIGINATION (0), EMERGENCY_CALL_RELEASE (1), MO_LR (2), EMERGENCY_CALL_HANDOVER (3), DEFERRED_MT_LR_RESPONSE (4), DELAYED_LOCATION_REPORTING (6), and HANDOVER_TO_5GC (7).

name: Pseudonym-Indicator
description: Says whether a pseudonym for the target UE is wanted instead of its real identity. Values are PSEUDONYM_NOT_REQUESTED (0), the default when absent, and PSEUDONYM_REQUESTED (1).

name: LCS-Service-Type-ID
description: Identifier of the LCS service type the client is using, chosen from the service types for which the client has permission to locate this UE.

name: LCS-Privacy-Check-Non-Session
description: Privacy handling to apply when the LCS client is not in a call or session with the target UE. It wraps one LCS-Privacy-Check value; when absent the default is ALLOWED_WITHOUT_NOTIFICATION.

name: LCS-Privacy-Check-Session
description: Privacy handling to apply when the LCS client has a call or session with the target UE. It wraps one LCS-Privacy-Check value; when absent the default is NOT_ALLOWED.

name: LCS-QoS-Class
description: Class of the requested location QoS. ASSURED (0) means the accuracy must be met or the result is unusable, while BEST EFFORT (1) accepts a result that misses the requested accuracy.

name: GERAN-Positioning-Info
description: Positioning information gathered over GERAN access. The group carries the GERAN positioning data and the GANSS positioning data elements from TS 49.031.

name: GERAN-Positioning-Data
description: Encoded Positioning Data element from TS 49.031, describing the positioning methods tried for a UE on GERAN and whether they succeeded.

name: GERAN-GANSS-Positioning-Data
description: Encoded GANSS Positioning Data element from TS 49.031, describing the satellite (GANSS) methods used to position a UE on GERAN.

name: UTRAN-Positioning-Info
description: Positioning information gathered over UTRAN access. The group carries the UTRAN positioning data, the GANSS positioning data, and any additional UTRAN positioning data.

name: UTRAN-Positioning-Data
description: Encoded UTRAN positioning data taken from the positionData element of RANAP (TS 25.413): the data discriminator and the data set that describe the methods used.

name: UTRAN-GANSS-Positioning-Data
description: Encoded GANSS positioning data set from the RANAP positionData element (TS 25.413), describing satellite methods used for a UE on UTRAN.

name: LRR-Flags
description: Bit mask sent by the MME or SGSN in a Location-Report-Request. Bit 0 Lgd/SLg-Indicator shows whether the sender is an SGSN on Lgd or an MME on SLg; bits 1 and 2 relate to the MO-LR short circuit feature on Lgd.

name: LCS-Reference-Number
description: One-octet reference number that ties together the messages of one deferred location request.

name: Deferred-Location-Type
description: Bit mask of the events that a deferred location request waits for. Bits include UE-Available (0), Entering-Into-Area (1), Leaving-From-Area (2), Being-Inside-Area (3), Periodic-LDR (4), and Motion-Event (5).

name: Area-Event-Info
description: Parameters of an area event for deferred location reporting: the area definition, whether the event fires once or many times, and timing limits such as the minimum and maximum report intervals and the reporting duration.

name: Area-Definition
description: Geographic target area for an area event. It holds one to ten Area entries and, except on Lgd, up to 240 Additional-Area entries.

name: Area
description: One area in an area definition, given as an area type plus the matching area identification.

name: Area-Type
description: Kind of area identifier in an Area or Additional-Area. Values include Country Code (0), PLMN ID (1), Location Area ID (2), Routing Area ID (3), Cell Global ID (4), UTRAN Cell ID (5), Tracking Area ID (6), and E-UTRAN Cell Global ID (7).

name: Area-Identification
description: Encoded identifier of the area for area-event deferred reporting. The coding depends on the Area-Type, following TS 29.002 for types 0 to 5 and TS 24.080 for tracking area and ECGI; EPC area events use only types 6 and 7.

name: Occurrence-Info
description: Says whether an area or motion event is reported only once or repeatedly. Values are ONE_TIME_EVENT (0), the default, and MULTIPLE_TIME_EVENT (1).

name: Interval-Time
description: Shortest gap, in seconds, allowed between successive area or motion event reports, from 1 to 32767 seconds. It applies only to repeated events.

name: Periodic-LDR-Information
description: Parameters for periodic deferred location reporting: how many reports to send and the interval between them. Their product must stay below roughly 100 days.

name: Reporting-Amount
description: Number of location reports to send for periodic deferred reporting, from 1 up to 8639999.

name: Reporting-PLMN-List
description: List of PLMNs in which the UE may produce periodic location reports, holding up to 20 PLMN entries and an indicator of whether the list is in priority order.

name: PLMN-ID-List
description: One PLMN entry in a reporting PLMN list: the visited PLMN identity and whether that PLMN supports periodic location.

name: PLR-Flags
description: Bit mask sent by the GMLC in a Provide-Location-Request. Bits are MO-LR-ShortCircuit-Indicator (0), Optimized-LCS-Proc-Req (1) for a combined MME/SGSN, and Delayed-Location-Reporting-Support-Indicator (2) for UEs that are briefly unreachable.

name: PLA-Flags
description: Bit mask sent by the MME or SGSN in a Provide-Location-Answer. Bits include Deferred-MT-LR-Response-Indicator (0), MO-LR-ShortCircuit-Indicator (1), Optimized-LCS-Proc-Performed (2), and UE-Transiently-Not-Reachable-Indicator (3).

name: Deferred-MT-LR-Data
description: Information about a deferred mobile-terminated location request reported to the GMLC: the deferred event type, an optional termination cause, and, on an MT-LR restart, the node the UE moved to.

name: Termination-Cause
description: Reason a deferred location procedure ended. Values include Normal (0), Error Undefined (1), Internal Timeout (2), Congestion (3), MT_LR_Restart (4), and Privacy Violation (5). MT_LR_Restart asks the GMLC to start over, for example after the UE changed serving node.

name: LRA-Flags
description: Bit mask sent by the GMLC in a Location-Report-Answer. Bit 0 MO-LR-ShortCircuit-Indicator shows that the MO-LR short circuit feature was used to get the estimate, on Lgd only.

name: Periodic-Location-Support-Indicator
description: Says whether the PLMN named in the same PLMN-ID-List entry supports periodic location. Values are NOT_SUPPORTED (0), the default, and SUPPORTED (1).

name: Prioritized-List-Indicator
description: Says whether the PLMN entries in a reporting PLMN list are in priority order. Values are NOT_PRIORITIZED (0), the default, and PRIORITIZED (1).

name: ESMLC-Cell-Info
description: Cell information that the E-SMLC supplies for the target UE: the ECGI of the cell and, when known, the cell portion in which the UE is located.

name: Civic-Address
description: Civic (street-style) address of the target UE, given as the XML document carried in the TS 29.171 Civic Address element.

name: Barometric-Pressure
description: Barometric pressure measured at the UE, as carried in the TS 29.171 element of the same name, which helps estimate altitude.

name: UTRAN-Additional-Positioning-Data
description: Additional UTRAN positioning data from the matching RANAP element of TS 25.413, sent alongside the other UTRAN positioning results.

name: Motion-Event-Info
description: Parameters of a motion event for a deferred EPC-MT-LR: the straight-line distance the UE must move, whether reporting repeats, and timing limits on reporting, sampling, and total duration.

name: Linear-Distance
description: Minimum straight-line distance, in meters (1 to 10000), that the UE must travel to trigger a motion event report in a deferred EPC-MT-LR.

name: Maximum-Interval
description: Longest allowed time, in seconds (1 to 86400), between successive event reports in a deferred EPC-MT-LR. Expiry of this interval is itself a reportable event.

name: Sampling-Interval
description: Longest time, in seconds (1 to 3600), that the UE may wait between checks of whether an area or motion event has happened, for a deferred EPC-MT-LR.

name: Reporting-Duration
description: Total time, in seconds (1 to 8640000), during which event reporting stays active for a deferred EPC-MT-LR.

name: Reporting-Location-Requirements
description: Bit string of location requirements for event reports in a deferred EPC-MT-LR. Bit 0 Location-Estimate means each report must include a location estimate; other bits are spare.

name: Additional-Area
description: An extra area in an area definition beyond the first ten, given as an area type and area identification. It is not used for a PS-MT-LR on Lgd.

name: HeNB-Local-IP-Address
description: The local IPv4 or IPv6 address of an H(e)NB. It is used when the access interworks with fixed broadband access.

name: UE-Local-IP-Address
description: The UE's local IPv4 or IPv6 address, as seen outside the 3GPP tunnel. It is used for fixed broadband interworking and untrusted WLAN access.

name: UDP-Source-Port
description: A UDP source port seen when NAT is detected. For fixed broadband interworking it is the port of the UE traffic after NAT. For untrusted WLAN over S2b it is the port of the UDP-wrapped IKEv2 tunnel to the ePDG.

name: AN-GW-Status
description: Sent from the PCEF to tell the PCRF the status of the SGW. The defined value AN_GW_FAILED (0) asks the PCRF to stop sending policy decisions until the gateway comes back.

name: User-Location-Info-Time
description: The NTP time when the UE was last known to be at the reported location. The PCEF sends it to the PCRF, and the PCRF can forward it to the AF. The spec defines this AVP as type Time.

name: Default-QoS-Information
description: The default QoS for an IP-CAN session over fixed broadband access. It is either a QCI with uplink and downlink maximum bit rates, or the name of a QoS profile preconfigured at the PCEF. From the PCEF it is what the network offers. From the PCRF it is the authorized value.

name: RAN-NAS-Release-Cause
description: The release cause from the RAN or NAS for EPS access, or from the TWAN or untrusted WLAN for non-3GPP EPS access. It is encoded like the GTPv2 RAN/NAS Cause field.

name: Presence-Reporting-Area-Information
description: Describes one Presence Reporting Area. It carries the area ID, the UE's status for that area or the area's own status, and, for an area that is specific to one UE, the list of its cells or tracking areas.

name: NetLoc-Access-Support
description: The level of NetLoc support offered by the access network now serving the UE. The value NETLOC_ACCESS_NOT_SUPPORTED (0) means that the access cannot supply access network information.

name: Fixed-User-Location-Info
description: The UE's location in a fixed access network. It is given by WLAN SSID and BSSID, or by logical and physical access identifiers.

name: PCSCF-Restoration-Indication
description: Asks for P-CSCF restoration for the UE. Its only value is PCSCF_RESTORATION (0).

name: Default-Access
description: The default access for an NBIFOM multi-access session. From the PCEF it is the access that the UE chose. From the PCRF it is the access that the PCRF chose. It takes IP-CAN-Type values, in practice 3GPP-EPS or Non-3GPP-EPS.

name: NBIFOM-Mode
description: The NBIFOM mode. In the initial CCR it is the mode the UE suggests, and in the CCA it is the mode the PCRF picks. Values are UE_INITIATED (0) and NETWORK_INITIATED (1).

name: NBIFOM-Support
description: NBIFOM support. In the initial CCR it says the UE and network support NBIFOM. In the CCA it says whether the PCRF allows NBIFOM for the session. Values are NBIFOM_NOT_SUPPORTED (0) and NBIFOM_SUPPORTED (1).

name: RAN-Rule-Support
description: Says the network supports the RAN rule indication used in WLAN offloading decisions. The defined value is 0 (RAN rule indication support).

name: Access-Availability-Change-Reason
description: Why the PCEF reports a change in whether an access is available in a multi-access session. Values are 0 (Access stratum indication) and 1 (Access usable/unusable).

name: Routing-Rule-Report
description: Reports NBIFOM routing rules that the PCRF could not install or modify, for example because of policy or subscription. It carries the rule identifiers, their status, and a failure code.

name: Conditional-Policy-Information
description: Policy values that the PCRF sends to take effect at a given execution time. It can carry default bearer QoS, APN-AMBR values, and conditional APN-AMBR values.

name: Removal-Of-Access
description: Sent by the PCRF to remove one access from a multi-access IP-CAN session. Its only value is REMOVAL_OF_ACCESS (0).

name: TCP-Source-Port
description: The TCP source port of an IKEv2 tunnel between the UE and the ePDG for untrusted WLAN over S2b. It applies when NAT and a firewall force the tunnel through a firewall traversal tunnel.

name: PRA-Install
description: Gives a list of new or changed Presence Reporting Areas for an IP-CAN session to report on. Each area is a Presence-Reporting-Area-Information entry.

name: PRA-Remove
description: Stops reporting for a list of Presence Reporting Areas on an IP-CAN session. Each area is named by its identifier.

name: 3GPP-PS-Data-Off-Status
description: The 3GPP PS Data Off state that the UE reports. Values are ACTIVE (0), when the user has turned on PS Data Off, and INACTIVE (1), the default.

name: Device-Action
description: The SCS's request on Tsp, carried in Device-Action-Request (DAR). It names the target device (External-Id or MSISDN), the SCS, the Action-Type, and the Reference-Number for the request. A recall or replace also carries Old-Reference-Number, and a new trigger carries Trigger-Data and a Validity-Time.

name: Device-Notification
description: The MTC-IWF's report back to the SCS on Tsp. It goes in Device-Action-Answer (DAA) to confirm a request, and in Device-Notification-Request (DNR) for delivery reports and MSISDN-less MO-SMS. It echoes the Reference-Number and Action-Type, and it can add Request-Status, Delivery-Outcome, MTC-Error-Diagnostic, SM-RP-UI and the application port.

name: Payload
description: The application data that a device trigger delivers to the UE. On Tsp it sits inside Trigger-Data in a DAR. The MTC-IWF then passes it to the SMS-SC as a top-level AVP of the T4 Device-Trigger-Request (DTR).

name: Priority-Indication
description: Marks a device trigger as Non-Priority (0) or Priority (1). The SCS sets it in Trigger-Data on Tsp. It also appears in the T4 Device-Trigger-Request and in T4-Parameters on S6m.

name: Reference-Number
description: A number that the party starting a transaction picks to identify it, then repeats in every related message. It is in Device-Action and Device-Notification on Tsp. On T4 it goes in DTR and DRR, so a delivery report can be matched to its trigger.

name: Application-Port-Identifier
description: Identifies the application on the UE that a trigger is for (the SMS application port, see TS 23.040). On Tsp it is in Trigger-Data and in the Device-Notification of an MSISDN-less MO-SMS DNR. On S6m it sits in Service-Parameters, and the T4 Device-Trigger-Request carries it under the name SMS-Application-Port-ID.

name: Old-Reference-Number
description: The Reference-Number of an earlier, still-pending trigger that a recall or replace targets. It is in Device-Action and Device-Notification on Tsp. On T4 it goes in the DTR and comes back in the DTA. Part of the Device-Trigger-Recall-Replace feature.

name: Feature-Supported-In-Final-Target
description: A bitmask in the Tsp Device-Action-Answer (DAA) that tells the SCS which features the final target node supports. Bit 0 is Device-Trigger-Recall-Replace supported in SMS-SC. If this bit is not set, the SCS does not send recalls and handles a replace as a new trigger.

name: User-Identifier
description: Groups the identities the HSS knows a UE by: IMSI in User-Name, MSISDN, External-Identifier, and on S6m/S6n also LMSI. It names the target in SIR and comes back in SIA. On S6t it names the UE or group in CIR and NIR and adds Type-Of-External-Identifier.

name: Service-ID
description: Names the service the MTC-IWF or MTC-AAA wants in an S6m/S6n SIR, so the HSS can check authorization and return the right data. Values are DEVICE_TRIGGER (0) and SMS_MO (1).

name: SCS-Identity
description: Identity of the SCS (or UE) that asked the MTC-IWF for a service, sent to the HSS in SIR so it can authorize the request. Encoding depends on the service; for device triggering it is the SCS's international E.164 number as a TBCD string, with no nature-of-address prefix.

name: Service-Parameters
description: Service-specific inputs the MTC-IWF passes to the HSS in SIR for the service named by Service-ID. It holds T4-Parameters for device triggering over SMS and an Application-Port-Identifier.

name: T4-Parameters
description: Device-trigger inputs inside Service-Parameters of an S6m SIR. It holds Priority-Indication, which says whether the trigger is priority or non-priority, and SM-RP-SMEA, the SMS address of the originating SME.

name: Service-Data
description: Service-specific results the HSS returns to the MTC-IWF in SIA for a device triggering request. In this release it only wraps T4-Data.

name: T4-Data
description: Tells the MTC-IWF in SIA where an SMS-based trigger can be delivered: the serving node (MSC, MME, SGSN, or IP-SM-GW) plus any additional serving nodes. It may instead carry HSS-Cause; when the subscriber is absent the serving node AVPs are left out.

name: HSS-Cause
description: Bit mask in T4-Data of an S6m SIA explaining why the HSS cannot offer a trigger path. Bit 0 Absent Subscriber (no suitable serving node registered), bit 1 Teleservice Not Provisioned, bit 2 Call Barred. Other bits are cleared by the HSS and ignored by the MTC-IWF.

name: SIR-Flags
description: Mandatory bit mask in SIR. Bit 0, S6m/S6n Indicator, is set when an MTC-IWF sends the request over S6m and cleared when an MTC-AAA sends it over S6n. Other bits are cleared by the sender and ignored by the HSS.

name: External-Identifier
description: An external identifier for a UE (or, on some interfaces, for a group of UEs) that applications outside the operator network use in place of the IMSI or MSISDN. Its format is set in TS 23.003. It appears in S6a subscription data and in Sh user identities.

name: AESE-Communication-Pattern
description: One communication pattern request from an SCEF for a UE, as stored with the subscription and passed to the MME or SGSN. It holds the SCEF identity, reference IDs to add or delete, and one or more Communication-Pattern-Set entries that describe expected UE traffic.

name: Communication-Pattern-Set
description: A description of how a UE is expected to communicate: whether traffic is periodic or on demand, interval and duration, scheduled time windows, whether the UE is stationary, its traffic profile, battery type, and an optional time after which the set expires.

name: Periodic-Communication-Indicator
description: Says whether the UE communicates on a regular schedule or only when needed. Values are PERIODICALLY (0) and ON_DEMAND (1); the duration and period fields are only meaningful with PERIODICALLY.

name: Communication-Duration-Time
description: The length, in seconds, of each periodic communication session the UE is expected to make, as part of a communication pattern.

name: Periodic-Time
description: An interval in seconds. In a communication pattern it is the gap between periodic communications; in a location reporting configuration it is the minimum period between location reports.

name: Scheduled-Communication-Time
description: A time window in which the UE is expected to communicate, given as days of the week plus start and end times of day. A missing part defaults to every day, start of day, or end of day.

name: Stationary-Indication
description: Says whether the UE is expected to stay in one place. Values are STATIONARY_UE (0) and MOBILE_UE (1).

name: AESE-Communication-Pattern-Config-Status
description: Per-pattern outcome the HSS returns in an S6t CIA for a communication pattern request. It names the pattern by SCEF-Reference-ID (or the Ext form), optionally SCEF-ID, and carries an AESE-Error-Report when handling failed.

name: AESE-Error-Report
description: Error detail for a failed communication pattern request, nested in AESE-Communication-Pattern-Config-Status of an S6t CIA. It wraps a Service-Result with the result code the HSS hit.

name: Monitoring-Event-Configuration
description: A monitoring event request that an SCEF places for a UE or group, which the HSS keeps in the subscription and passes to the MME or SGSN over S6a. It names the monitoring type and SCEF, the reference IDs to create or delete, limits on report count and duration, and type-specific settings.

name: Monitoring-Event-Report
description: A report of a detected monitoring event, sent back toward the SCEF. It carries the SCEF reference, the monitoring type, and the event data, such as reachability, location, roaming status, IMEI change, loss of connectivity reason, idle status, or PDN connectivity status.

name: SCEF-Reference-ID
description: A 32-bit identifier that the SCEF assigns to a monitoring event or communication pattern request. Together with the SCEF-ID it links configurations, status answers, and reports to the original request.

name: SCEF-ID
description: The Diameter identity of the SCEF that originated a monitoring, communication pattern, or non-IP data delivery request. In S6a subscription data it also names the SCEF to use for an APN.

name: SCEF-Reference-ID-for-Deletion
description: A 32-bit SCEF reference ID, scoped by the SCEF-ID, that marks an existing monitoring event or communication pattern configuration for removal.

name: Monitoring-Type
description: The kind of monitoring event being configured or reported. Values include LOSS_OF_CONNECTIVITY (0), UE_REACHABILITY (1), LOCATION_REPORTING (2), CHANGE_OF_IMSI_IMEI(SV)_ASSOCIATION (3), ROAMING_STATUS (4), COMMUNICATION_FAILURE (5), and PDN_CONNECTIVITY_STATUS (10).

name: Maximum-Number-of-Reports
description: The maximum number of event reports to send to the SCEF before a monitoring configuration lapses. It is limited to one for some request types and is not used for availability after DDN failure.

name: UE-Reachability-Configuration
description: Settings for UE reachability monitoring: whether reachability for SMS or for data is wanted, the tolerated downlink latency, how long the UE should stay reachable, and a suggested downlink buffering packet count.

name: Monitoring-Duration
description: The absolute time at which a monitoring event configuration expires. If a report limit is also set, the first condition reached ends the configuration.

name: Maximum-Detection-Time
description: The number of seconds without any contact from the UE after which the SCEF is told the UE is unreachable. The HSS uses it when it sets the subscribed periodic RAU/TAU timer.

name: Reachability-Type
description: A bit mask choosing which reachability to monitor: bit 0 Reachability for SMS (the default) and bit 1 Reachability for Data. Only one bit may be set.

name: Maximum-Latency
description: The longest delay, in seconds, the application accepts before downlink data reaches the UE. The HSS uses it to derive the subscribed periodic RAU/TAU timer.

name: Maximum-Response-Time
description: How long, in seconds, the UE should remain reachable after it becomes reachable, so that pending downlink data can be delivered. The HSS uses it to set the active time.

name: Location-Information-Configuration
description: Settings for location reporting as a monitoring event: whether current or last known location is wanted, the granularity required, and the minimum interval between reports.

name: MONTE-Location-Type
description: The type of location wanted for location reporting. Values are CURRENT_LOCATION (0) and LAST_KNOWN_LOCATION (1), the default.

name: Accuracy
description: The granularity of location wanted in a location reporting request. Values are CGI-ECGI (0), eNB (1), LA-TA-RA (2), PRA (3), and PLMN-ID (4).

name: Association-Type
description: Controls what change in the IMSI and device pairing triggers a report. IMEI-CHANGE (0) reports only a new IMEI; IMEISV-CHANGE (1) also reports when only the software version changes.

name: Roaming-Information
description: The roaming status reported for a subscriber in a monitoring event. Values are SUBSCRIBER_ROAMING (0) and SUBSCRIBER_NOT_ROAMING (1).

name: Reachability-Information
description: The kind of reachability reported for a UE in a monitoring event. Values are REACHABLE_FOR_SMS (0) and REACHABLE_FOR_DATA (1).

name: IMEI-Change
description: A bit mask that reports what changed in the device paired with the IMSI: bit 0 IMEI (the device changed) or bit 1 IMEISV (only the software version changed). The new values can go in Terminal-Information.

name: Monitoring-Event-Config-Status
description: The outcome of processing a monitoring event configuration, tied to its SCEF reference ID. It holds one or more service reports with result codes and the type of node that produced them.

name: CIR-Flags
description: Bit mask in an S6t CIR that asks the HSS for bulk or query actions. Bit 0 delete all monitoring events, bit 1 query Enhanced Coverage restriction, bit 2 retrieve the IMSI Group Id for an External Group Identifier, bit 3 delete all communication patterns, bit 4 delete all network parameter configurations.

name: Service-Result
description: An error or result code for a requested monitoring action. It holds a Service-Result-Code and a Vendor-Id that shows whether the code is a 3GPP experimental result (10415) or a base protocol result (0 or absent).

name: Service-Result-Code
description: The numeric result for a monitoring action, which is either a 3GPP-defined Experimental-Result-Code value or a Result-Code from the Diameter base protocol.

name: Reference-ID-Validity-Time
description: The time at which the communication pattern sets tied to an SCEF reference ID become invalid and are removed. If absent, the set does not expire.

name: Event-handling
description: Reports what has happened to an existing monitoring event, so the SCEF knows its state. Values are SUSPEND (0), RESUME (1), and CANCEL (2).

name: NIDD-Authorization-Request
description: SCEF request in an S6t NIR to authorize non-IP data delivery (NIDD) for a UE. It holds the APN in Service-Selection and an optional Requested-Validity-Time for the authorization.

name: NIDD-Authorization-Response
description: HSS reply in an S6t NIA to a NIDD authorization request. It returns the UE's MSISDN, IMSI (in User-Name), and External-Identifier as available, plus a Granted-Validity-Time when the HSS limits how long the authorization lasts.

name: Service-Report
description: The result of a requested monitoring action from one node, with the service result and the type of node (HSS, MME, or SGSN) that produced it.

name: Node-Type
description: The type of node that sent a monitoring result or report. Values are HSS (0), MME (1), and SGSN (2).

name: S6t-HSS-Cause
description: Bit mask the HSS sends to the SCEF in CIA or inside a Group-Report-Item. Bit 0 Absent Subscriber: the configuration could not reach a serving node or the UE is not reachable there. Bit 1 Group Event Monitoring Partially Cancel: group monitoring was cancelled for this member.

name: Enhanced-Coverage-Restriction
description: Enhanced Coverage restriction settings the SCEF sends to the HSS in an S6t CIR. It carries either a Restricted-PLMN-List or an Allowed-PLMN-List, each a complete and possibly empty set of serving PLMNs.

name: Enhanced-Coverage-Restriction-Data
description: Current Enhanced Coverage restriction state the HSS returns in an S6t CIA when the SCEF set the Enhanced Coverage Query bit of CIR-Flags. It holds the Enhanced-Coverage-Restriction setting and the current Visited-PLMN-Id if any.

name: Restricted-PLMN-List
description: Inside Enhanced-Coverage-Restriction, the full set of serving PLMNs where Enhanced Coverage is restricted, as Visited-PLMN-Id entries. An empty list means Enhanced Coverage is allowed in every serving PLMN.

name: Allowed-PLMN-List
description: Inside Enhanced-Coverage-Restriction, the full set of serving PLMNs where Enhanced Coverage is allowed, as Visited-PLMN-Id entries. An empty list means Enhanced Coverage is restricted in every serving PLMN.

name: Requested-Validity-Time
description: Time the SCEF proposes in NIDD-Authorization-Request of an S6t NIR, after which it will treat the granted NIDD authorization as revoked without further signalling.

name: Granted-Validity-Time
description: Expiry time of a NIDD authorization, set by the HSS in NIDD-Authorization-Response or APN-Validity-Time. After it, the HSS drops the stored authorization and the SCEF treats it as revoked; a time in the past means immediate revocation.

name: NIDD-Authorization-Update
description: Carried in an S6t NIR sent by the HSS to the SCEF to change or revoke NIDD authorizations it granted earlier, when both support NIDD Authorization Update. It holds one or more APN-Validity-Time entries.

name: Loss-Of-Connectivity-Reason
description: Why a loss of connectivity event was reported. Values include UE_DETACHED_MME (0), UE_DETACHED_SGSN (1), MAX_DETECTION_TIME_EXPIRED_MME (2), and UE_PURGED_MME (4), with matching SGSN variants.

name: Group-Reporting-Guard-Timer
description: Interval in seconds the SCEF sets in an S6t CIR for group monitoring. The HSS must send the aggregated reports and status for group members in RIR no later than this. Required when the target is an External Group Identifier.

name: CIA-Flags
description: Bit mask in an S6t CIA. Bit 0, Group-Configuration-In-Progress, means the HSS is still handling a group monitoring configuration and will send further status in later RIR commands. Other bits are cleared and ignored.

name: Group-Report
description: Aggregated report the HSS sends to the SCEF in an S6t RIR for a group-based monitoring event or network configuration. It names the request by SCEF-Reference-ID (or Ext) and SCEF-ID and holds one Group-Report-Item per member UE.

name: Group-Report-Item
description: One member UE's entry in a Group-Report. It names the UE in User-Identifier and can carry the same event data as a Monitoring-Event-Report (location, reachability, roaming, IMEI change, and so on) plus S6t-HSS-Cause, a Reporting-Time-Stamp, and Updated-Network-Configuration.

name: RIR-Flags
description: Bit mask in an S6t RIR from the HSS. Bit 0 Group-Configuration-In-Progress, bit 1 All-Monitoring-Events-Cancelled, bit 2 Change-Of-Authorized-Monitoring-Events, bit 3 All-Communication-Pattern-Cancelled, bit 4 All-Suggested-Network-Configuration-Cancelled.

name: Type-Of-External-Identifier
description: Says what the External-Identifier next to it in User-Identifier names. EXTERNAL-UE-IDENTIFIER-TYPE (0) is a single UE and EXTERNAL-GROUP-IDENTIFIER-TYPE (1) is a group of UEs. When absent, the identifier is for a single UE.

name: APN-Validity-Time
description: One entry of NIDD-Authorization-Update giving a new Granted-Validity-Time for the NIDD authorization on the APN in Service-Selection. Without an APN the time applies to every NIDD authorization the UE holds, and only one such entry may be sent.

name: Suggested-Network-Configuration
description: Network parameter configuration the SCEF suggests in an S6t CIR, such as periodic RAU/TAU timer, active time, and suggested downlink buffering packet count, keyed by SCEF-ID and reference ID. The HSS can return the active values in CIA.

name: Monitoring-Event-Report-Status
description: SCEF's per-report result in an S6t RIA, telling the HSS how each received monitoring event report was handled. It names the report by SCEF-Reference-ID (or Ext) and SCEF-ID and gives a Result-Code or Experimental-Result-Code.

name: PLMN-ID-Requested
description: Says whether roaming status reports should include the serving PLMN ID. Values are TRUE (0), the default, and FALSE (1).

name: AdditionalIdentifiers
description: Extra External Group Identifiers the SCEF adds to an S6t CIR when it wants IMSI Group IDs for several groups at once. The first group goes in User-Identifier and the rest go here.

name: NIR-Flags
description: Bit mask in an S6t NIR. Bit 0, Incomplete Group-User-Identifier-List, is set while more segments of a group's member list will follow in later NIR commands and cleared on the last segment.

name: Reporting-Time-Stamp
description: Time a report for one group member was produced, carried in a Group-Report-Item of an S6t RIR so the SCEF can tell when each member's event happened.

name: Group-User-Identifier
description: One member of a UE group, listed in S6t NIA (or later HSS-sent NIR segments) after a NIDD authorization for an External Group Identifier. It gives the member's IMSI in User-Name and its MSISDN or External-Identifier. TS 29.230 assigns it code 3176; TS 29.336 lists it as 3177.

name: NIA-Flags
description: Bit mask in an S6t NIA. Bit 0, Incomplete Group-User-Identifier-List, means the HSS could not fit the whole group member list and will send the remaining segments in later NIR commands. Other bits are cleared and ignored. TS 29.230 assigns it code 3177; TS 29.336 lists it as 3176.

name: MTC-Provider-Info
description: Information about the MTC service provider or MTC application on whose behalf a monitoring or communication pattern request is made. It holds the MTC-Provider-ID.

name: MTC-Provider-ID
description: A text identity for the MTC service provider or MTC application behind a request.

name: PDN-Connectivity-Status-Configuration
description: Requests monitoring of PDN connectivity status. If it contains an APN in Service-Selection, monitoring covers that APN only; otherwise it covers all APNs.

name: PDN-Connectivity-Status-Report
description: A PDN connectivity status event for one APN. It says whether a PDN connection was created or deleted, whether it is IP (with PDN type and UE addresses) or non-IP, and how non-IP data is delivered.

name: PDN-Connectivity-Status-Type
description: Whether a monitored PDN connection was set up or torn down. Values are CREATED (0) and DELETED (1).

name: Traffic-Profile
description: The expected shape of UE traffic in a communication pattern. Values include SINGLE_TRANSMISSION_UL (0), SINGLE_TRANSMISSION_DL (1), dual transmissions with a reply in the other direction (2, 3), and MULTI_TRANSMISSION (4).

name: Updated-Network-Configuration
description: Network parameter values the HSS reports to the SCEF in an S6t RIR when a stored configuration changed because of a later CIR. Inside a Group-Report-Item it gives the values in force for that member. It holds periodic RAU/TAU timer, active time, and buffering count.

name: Battery-Indicator
description: A bit mask that describes the UE power source in a communication pattern: bit 0 NO_BATTERY, bit 1 BATTERY_REPLACEABLE_INDICATION, and bit 2 BATTERY_RECHARGEABLE_INDICATION.

name: SCEF-Reference-ID-Ext
description: A 64-bit form of the SCEF reference ID, used in place of SCEF-Reference-ID when the SCEF and HSS both support the Extended Reference IDs feature.

name: SCEF-Reference-ID-for-Deletion-Ext
description: A 64-bit form of the reference ID that marks a configuration for removal, used in place of SCEF-Reference-ID-for-Deletion when the Extended Reference IDs feature is supported.

name: Exclude-Identifiers
description: A list of UEs, by External-Identifier or MSISDN, to remove from an existing group monitoring configuration.

name: Include-Identifiers
description: A list of UEs, by External-Identifier or MSISDN, to add to an existing group monitoring configuration.

name: SM-Delivery-Outcome-T4
description: The SMS-SC's result for a device trigger, carried in the T4 Delivery-Report-Request (DRR). Values are ABSENT_SUBSCRIBER (0), UE_MEMORY_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED (1), SUCCESSFUL_TRANSFER (2), and VALIDITY_TIME_EXPIRED (3). The MTC-IWF maps it to Delivery-Outcome on Tsp.

name: Absent-Subscriber-Diagnostic-T4
description: Gives the reason the UE was absent when a trigger failed with ABSENT_SUBSCRIBER, carried in the T4 DRR. Values are NO_PAGING_RESPONSE (0), UE_DETACHED (1), UE_DEREGISTERED (2), UE_PURGED (3), ROAMING_RESTRICTION (4), and UNIDENTIFIED_SUBSCRIBER (5). It does not go on to the SCS.

name: Trigger-Action
description: Tells the SMS-SC what to do with a trigger in the T4 Device-Trigger-Request, and comes back in the DTA. Values are TRIGGER (0) to store and send a new trigger, RECALL (1) to delete a pending one, and REPLACE (2) to swap a pending one for a new one.

name: MTC-Error-Diagnostic
description: Gives more detail when an SMS-SC trigger replace fails. It is carried in the T4 Device-Trigger-Answer (DTA) and passed on to the SCS in Device-Notification on Tsp. Values are ORIGINAL_MESSAGE_NOT_DELETED (0) and NEW_MESSAGE_NOT_STORED (1).

name: SC-Address
description: E.164 number of the service centre (SMS-SC) or MTC-IWF the short message belongs to, carried as bare TBCD digits with no nature-of-address or numbering-plan prefix. It appears in SRR, ALR and RDR on S6c and in OFR and TFR on SGd/Gdd.

name: SM-RP-UI
description: The SMS TPDU itself (TS 23.040), i.e. the relay-layer user data, capped at 200 octets. It is mandatory in OFR and TFR, and an OFA or TFA can return one carrying the delivery acknowledgement.

name: TFR-Flags
description: Bit mask the SMS-GMSC sends in a TFR toward the MME or SGSN. Only bit 0, More-Messages-To-Send, is defined: when set, the service centre has further short messages queued for the same UE. Undefined bits are sent as zero and ignored.

name: SM-Delivery-Failure-Cause
description: Why an MO or MT short message could not be delivered, returned in OFA or TFA when the result is DIAMETER_ERROR_SM_DELIVERY_FAILURE. The group holds a mandatory SM-Enumerated-Delivery-Failure-Cause and an optional SM-Diagnostic-Info.

name: SM-Enumerated-Delivery-Failure-Cause
description: Failure reason inside SM-Delivery-Failure-Cause, mirroring the MAP SM-EnumeratedDeliveryFailureCause. Values are MEMORY_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED (0), EQUIPMENT_PROTOCOL_ERROR (1), EQUIPMENT_NOT_SM-EQUIPPED (2), UNKNOWN_SERVICE_CENTRE (3), SC-CONGESTION (4), INVALID_SME-ADDRESS (5), and USER_NOT_SC-USER (6).

name: SM-Diagnostic-Info
description: Optional extra diagnostic octets that accompany the enumerated cause inside SM-Delivery-Failure-Cause, giving more detail about a failed delivery in OFA or TFA.

name: SM-Delivery-Timer
description: Length in seconds of the SM delivery supervision timer the SMS-GMSC runs for this message. The SMS-GMSC puts it in TFR so an MME or S4-SGSN serving a UE in extended idle mode DRX can judge whether paging can finish in time.

name: SM-Delivery-Start-Time
description: UTC timestamp at which the SMS-GMSC started its SM delivery supervision timer, sent in TFR alongside SM-Delivery-Timer so the MME or SGSN knows how much of the delivery window remains.

name: SM-RP-MTI
description: RP message type of the short message the SMS-GMSC is about to deliver, sent in SRR so the HSS can tell a status report apart from an ordinary MT message. Values are SM_DELIVER (0) and SM_STATUS_REPORT (1).

name: SM-RP-SMEA
description: Address of the short message entity that originated the SM (the RP originating SME address), formatted per the TS 23.040 address rules. The SMS-GMSC includes it in SRR on S6c; other SMS-related applications reuse it.

name: SRR-Flags
description: Bit mask the SMS-GMSC sends in SRR. Bit 0 GPRS-Indicator says it can take two serving node addresses back; bit 1 SM-RP-PRI asks for delivery even if a service centre address is already in Message Waiting Data; bit 2 Single-Attempt-Delivery limits the SM to one try.

name: SM-Delivery-Not-Intended
description: Present in SRR when the requester only wants routing data and does not plan to deliver a message. Values are ONLY_IMSI_REQUESTED (0) and ONLY_MCC_MNC_REQUESTED (1). The SMS Router must act on it; the HSS may.

name: MWD-Status
description: Bit mask in SRA reporting Message Waiting Data state in the HSS. Bit 0 SC-Address Not included, bit 1 MNRF-Set, bit 2 MCEF-Set, bit 3 MNRG-Set, and bit 4 MNR5G-Set (waiting for the UE to become reachable via a 5G serving node).

name: MME-Absent-User-Subscriber-Diagnostic-SM
description: Reason the MME last gave for the user being absent, as stored in the HSS and returned to the SMS-GMSC in SRA. The spec names it MME-Absent-User-Diagnostic-SM; values come from TS 23.040 clause 3.3.2.

name: MSC-Absent-User-Subscriber-Diagnostic-SM
description: Reason the MSC last gave for the user being absent, as stored in the HSS and returned to the SMS-GMSC in SRA. The spec names it MSC-Absent-User-Diagnostic-SM; values come from TS 23.040 clause 3.3.2.

name: SGSN-Absent-User-Subscriber-Diagnostic-SM
description: Reason the SGSN last gave for the user being absent, as stored in the HSS and returned to the SMS-GMSC in SRA. The spec names it SGSN-Absent-User-Diagnostic-SM (heading SGSN-Absent-Subscriber-Diagnostic-SM); values come from TS 23.040 clause 3.3.2.

name: SM-Delivery-Outcome
description: Result of an SM delivery attempt, used so the HSS can update Message Waiting Data. Mandatory in RDR and, for MSISDN-less IMS delivery, sent in OFR. It holds one per-node outcome group for the MME, MSC, SGSN, IP-SM-GW, or SMSF over 3GPP or non-3GPP access.

name: MME-SM-Delivery-Outcome
description: Delivery outcome for an attempt made through an MME, carried inside SM-Delivery-Outcome. It holds an SM-Delivery-Cause and, when the user was absent, an Absent-User-Diagnostic-SM.

name: MSC-SM-Delivery-Outcome
description: Delivery outcome for an attempt made through an MSC, carried inside SM-Delivery-Outcome. It holds an SM-Delivery-Cause and, when the user was absent, an Absent-User-Diagnostic-SM.

name: SGSN-SM-Delivery-Outcome
description: Delivery outcome for an attempt made through an SGSN, carried inside SM-Delivery-Outcome. It holds an SM-Delivery-Cause and, when the user was absent, an Absent-User-Diagnostic-SM.

name: IP-SM-GW-SM-Delivery-Outcome
description: Delivery outcome for an attempt made through an IP-SM-GW, carried inside SM-Delivery-Outcome in RDR or OFR. It holds an SM-Delivery-Cause and, when the user was absent, an Absent-User-Diagnostic-SM.

name: SM-Delivery-Cause
description: Outcome code inside each per-node delivery outcome group, telling the HSS how to set Message Waiting Data. Values are UE_MEMORY_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED (0), ABSENT_USER (1), and SUCCESSFUL_TRANSFER (2).

name: Absent-User-Diagnostic-SM
description: Diagnostic code explaining why the subscriber was absent, with values from TS 23.040 clause 3.3.2. It sits inside the per-node delivery outcome groups in RDR and can be returned by the MME or SGSN in TFA with DIAMETER_ERROR_ABSENT_USER.

name: RDR-Flags
description: Bit mask the SMS-GMSC or IP-SM-GW sends in RDR. Only bit 0, Single-Attempt-Delivery, is defined: when set, the message was meant for a single delivery attempt. Undefined bits are sent as zero and ignored.

name: SMSMI-Correlation-ID
description: Identifiers for MSISDN-less SMS delivery in IMS (TS 23.204), carried in SRR, ALR, RDR, OFR and TFR. The group holds an optional HSS-ID plus Originating-SIP-URI and Destination-SIP-URI naming the sending and receiving IMS users.

name: OFR-Flags
description: Bit mask the MME or SGSN sends in OFR. Only bit 0, S6a/S6d-Indicator, is defined: set means the request went over Gdd from an SGSN; clear means it went over SGd from an MME.

name: Maximum-UE-Availability-Time
description: The UTC time until which a UE that uses a power saving mode, such as extended idle mode DRX, is expected to stay reachable. It is reported in UE reachability and availability notifications.

name: Maximum-Retransmission-Time
description: UTC time until which the SMS-GMSC is able to retry an MT short message, sent in TFR. Its presence lets an MME or SGSN serving a power-saving UE answer with a Requested-Retransmission-Time instead of a plain failure; SMS-GMSC-Address must accompany it.

name: Requested-Retransmission-Time
description: UTC time at which the MME or SGSN asks the SMS-GMSC to resend the MT short message, returned in TFA with DIAMETER_ERROR_ABSENT_USER when the UE uses a power-saving mode and the TFR carried a Maximum-Retransmission-Time.

name: SMS-GMSC-Address
description: E.164 number of the SMS-GMSC, or of the SMS Router when it relays the request, as bare TBCD digits. It goes in TFR whenever Maximum-Retransmission-Time is present so the MME or SGSN knows where to send a later alert.

name: SMS-GMSC-Alert-Event
description: Bit mask in an ALR from the MME or SGSN to the SMS-GMSC saying what triggered the alert. Bit 0 UE-Available-For-MT-SMS means the UE can now receive; bit 1 UE-Under-New-Serving-Node means it moved to another MME or SGSN.

name: SMSF-3GPP-Absent-User-Diagnostic-SM
description: Reason the SMSF registered for 3GPP access gave for the user being absent, returned by the HSS in SRA when the requester supports the SMSF-Support feature. Values come from TS 23.040 clause 3.3.2.

name: SMSF-Non-3GPP-Absent-User-Diagnostic-SM
description: Reason the SMSF registered for non-3GPP access gave for the user being absent, returned by the HSS in SRA when the requester supports the SMSF-Support feature. Values come from TS 23.040 clause 3.3.2.

name: SMSF-3GPP-SM-Delivery-Outcome
description: Delivery outcome for an attempt made through the SMSF registered for 3GPP access, carried inside SM-Delivery-Outcome. It holds an SM-Delivery-Cause and, when the user was absent, an Absent-User-Diagnostic-SM.

name: SMSF-Non-3GPP-SM-Delivery-Outcome
description: Delivery outcome for an attempt made through the SMSF registered for non-3GPP access, carried inside SM-Delivery-Outcome. It holds an SM-Delivery-Cause and, when the user was absent, an Absent-User-Diagnostic-SM.

name: SMSF-3GPP-Number
description: ISDN (E.164) number of the SMSF registered for 3GPP access, encoded as bare TBCD digits without address-type prefix. It is carried inside SMSF-3GPP-Address in SRA.

name: SMSF-Non-3GPP-Number
description: ISDN (E.164) number of the SMSF registered for non-3GPP access, encoded as bare TBCD digits without address-type prefix. It is carried inside SMSF-Non-3GPP-Address in SRA.

name: SMSF-3GPP-Name
description: Diameter identity (host name) of the SMSF serving the user over 3GPP access, carried inside SMSF-3GPP-Address in SRA so the SMS-GMSC can reach that SMSF.

name: SMSF-Non-3GPP-Name
description: Diameter identity (host name) of the SMSF serving the user over non-3GPP access, carried inside SMSF-Non-3GPP-Address in SRA so the SMS-GMSC can reach that SMSF.

name: SMSF-3GPP-Realm
description: Diameter realm of the SMSF serving the user over 3GPP access, carried inside SMSF-3GPP-Address in SRA alongside the SMSF name and number.

name: SMSF-Non-3GPP-Realm
description: Diameter realm of the SMSF serving the user over non-3GPP access, carried inside SMSF-Non-3GPP-Address in SRA alongside the SMSF name and number.

name: SMSF-3GPP-Address
description: The SMSF serving the user over 3GPP access, returned by the HSS in SRA when delivery is intended and SMSF-Support is negotiated. The group holds the SMSF number, name, realm, and its SBI support indicator.

name: SMSF-Non-3GPP-Address
description: The SMSF serving the user over non-3GPP access, returned by the HSS in SRA when delivery is intended and SMSF-Support is negotiated. The group holds the SMSF number, name, realm, and its SBI support indicator.

name: SMSF-3GPP-SBI-Support-Indicator
description: Inside SMSF-3GPP-Address, says whether that SMSF supports the service-based interface. Values are NOT_SUPPORT_SBI (0) and SUPPORT_SBI (1).

name: SMSF-Non-3GPP-SBI-Support-Indicator
description: Inside SMSF-Non-3GPP-Address, says whether that SMSF supports the service-based interface. Values are NOT_SUPPORT_SBI (0) and SUPPORT_SBI (1).

name: ProSe-Subscription-Data
description: The Proximity Services subscription of a user: the ProSe features the user may use, the PLMNs where each is allowed, and optional charging characteristics. It is held with the S6a subscription data.

name: ProSe-Permission
description: A bit mask of the ProSe features the user is subscribed to. Bits include ProSe Direct Discovery (0), EPC-level ProSe Discovery (1), one-to-many (3) and one-to-one (4) direct communication, UE-to-Network Relay (5), and Remote-UE-access (6).

name: ProSe-Allowed-PLMN
description: A PLMN where the UE may use ProSe discovery or direct communication, with the services allowed there and, for the home PLMN, the authorized discovery range.

name: ProSe-Direct-Allowed
description: A bit mask of the ProSe direct services the UE may use in one PLMN. Bits include Announce (0), Monitor (1), Communication (2), One-to-one Communication (3), Discoverer (4), Discoveree (5), and restricted discovery options.

name: Authorized-Discovery-Range
