description: The announcing range (short, medium, or long) that the UE may use for ProSe discovery in the home PLMN, based on its announcing policy.

name: eNodeB-Id
description: The identity of the eNodeB where the UE is now located, coded as in GTPv2. In S6a it is part of MME location information.

name: Extended-eNodeB-ID
description: The identity of the eNodeB where the UE is now located, using the extended macro eNodeB ID format from GTPv2. In S6a it is part of MME location information.

name: Reference-Id
description: An identifier that the PCRF assigns to a background data transfer policy and keeps unique within the PLMN. On Rx the AF supplies it so the PCRF can find that policy in the SPR.

name: Number-Of-UEs
description: A count of UEs. On Nt the SCEF sends the expected number of UEs for a background data transfer request to the PCRF. On S6t the HSS returns it in CIA as the size of the group when the CIR targeted an External Group Identifier.

name: Serving-PLMN-Rate-Control
description: The serving PLMN rate control limits for a UE, which the MME or SGSN sends to the SCEF in a T6a/T6b Connection-Management-Request (CMR) so that the SCEF can enforce them. It holds an Uplink-Rate-Limit and a Downlink-Rate-Limit. A limit of 0 means rate control is off in that direction. An active limit is at least 10.

name: Uplink-Rate-Limit
description: The maximum number of uplink NAS data PDUs that the UE can send per deci-hour (6 minutes). It is part of Serving-PLMN-Rate-Control in a T6a/T6b CMR. 0 turns uplink rate control off.

name: Downlink-Rate-Limit
description: The maximum number of downlink NAS data PDUs that the UE can receive per deci-hour (6 minutes). It is part of Serving-PLMN-Rate-Control in a T6a/T6b CMR. 0 turns downlink rate control off.

name: Extended-PCO
description: The contents of the extended protocol configuration options (ePCO) IE from TS 24.301, from octet 4 onward. It is exchanged in T6a/T6b CMR and CMA, and the MME or SGSN relays it transparently to and from the UE. A common use is to give the UE APN rate control information.

name: Connection-Action
description: Says what a T6a/T6b Connection-Management-Request (CMR) does to the SCEF connection. Values are CONNECTION_ESTABLISHMENT (0), CONNECTION_RELEASE (1), and CONNECTION_UPDATE (2).

name: Non-IP-Data
description: The non-IP user data (NIDD) payload that goes between the MME or SGSN and the SCEF. It is carried in MO-Data-Request (ODR) for uplink and MT-Data-Request (TDR) for downlink on T6a/T6b.

name: SCEF-Wait-Time
description: A UTC time in the T6a/T6b MT-Data-Request (TDR). It tells the MME or SGSN how long the SCEF will wait for an answer about the downlink non-IP data delivery.

name: CMR-Flags
description: A bitmask in the T6a/T6b Connection-Management-Request (CMR). Bit 0 is UE-Reachable-Indicator, which shows that the UE has become reachable or soon will be. Other bits are cleared when sent and ignored when received.

name: RRC-Cause-Counter
description: Counts how often the RRC establishment cause "MO Exception data" was seen, and when it was first seen. The MME or SGSN reports it to the SCEF in the T6a/T6b MO-Data-Request (ODR). It holds Counter-Value and RRC-Counter-Timestamp.

name: Counter-Value
description: The number of times that the RRC cause "MO Exception data" has been received for the UE. It is part of RRC-Cause-Counter in a T6a/T6b ODR.

name: RRC-Counter-Timestamp
description: A timestamp in RRC-Cause-Counter that records when the RRC cause "MO Exception data" was first received. It is carried in a T6a/T6b ODR.

name: TDA-Flags
description: A bitmask in the T6a/T6b MT-Data-Answer (TDA). Bit 0 is Acknowledged Delivery, which shows that the eNodeB has confirmed the downlink non-IP data was delivered. Other bits are cleared when sent and ignored when received.

name: Idle-Status-Indication
description: Details about a UE that has entered idle mode: when it happened, the active time, periodic RAU/TAU timer, and eDRX cycle granted by the MME or SGSN, and the suggested downlink buffering packet count.

name: Idle-Status-Timestamp
description: The time at which the UE entered idle mode, reported as part of an idle status indication.

name: Active-Time
description: An active time in seconds for the UE. It is the time granted by the MME or SGSN in an idle status report, or the subscribed value in S6a subscription data.

name: Reachability-Cause
description: Why a UE is reported as reachable. Values are CHANGE_TO_CONNECTED_MODE (0) and REACHABLE_FOR_PAGING (1).

name: APN-Rate-Control-Status
description: Saved APN rate control state for a UE, in the TS 29.274 encoding. It holds the allowed uplink and downlink packet counts, the number of additional exception reports, and a validity time. The SCEF returns it in the T6a/T6b CMA on connection release. The MME or SGSN can send it back in a CMR on establishment.
